title: Deep learning radiomics on X-rays separates acute from chronic vertebral fractures
summary: ResNet-50 deep transfer features pre-trained on RadImageNet or ImageNet were fused with radiomics features and classified with LightGBM using MRI bone marrow edema as the reference in 942 cases from three hospitals. The RadImageNet model reached AUC 0.967 internally, 0.886 externally and 0.933 prospectively (n=75), versus 0.629, 0.817 and 0.661 for the ImageNet model.
ai_technology: ResNet-50 transfer learning with radiomics fusion and LightGBM
organization: Shanghai Tenth People's Hospital; Nanjing Medical University

evidence.tested: Internal (n=178), external (n=111) and prospective (n=75) validation cohorts.
evidence.unknown: Small prospective cohort; model development retrospective; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep transfer learning features and machine learning classify fracture acuity from X-rays.
